decisions.reason: After several years on the market, continued offering would suggest acceptable uptake and the tray blanks remain a low-cost, strategically fitting dental consumable option worth retaining.
This thermoforming blank sits very close to the firm's established materials and laboratory workflow business, so if it is still marketed in 2022 the firm would likely continue to keep it.
The contrast spray still fits the firm's digital and clinical workflow orientation, but its more niche application makes it somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning than the core materials lines.

Custom earmolds draw directly on the firm's hearing-care channels and custom manufacturing capabilities, so a product line still on the market by 2022 would likely be viewed as a valuable option to maintain.
